svg.text: PR #2203 · Add federated portal views design
Each portal was an island: one origin, one cookie, one account per browser view.
The design links portals as scoped per-account connections, so one view drives all.
BEFORE
AFTER
utils::get_base_url
api_url and get_ws_url derive from window.location:
the frontend can only talk to the portal that served it.
/ws/client authenticated by cc_session cookie
Bearer works for REST, but a browser cannot set headers
on a WebSocket, and the cookie never crosses sites.
Two portals = two tabs, two logins
txcl.io as meawoppl@gmail.com and
portal.cosmicfrontier.org as matt@cosmicfrontier.org
never appear in one rail.
PortalClient per (portal, account)
Home frontend keeps one client per linked connection;
every key is (portal, account, session).
linked_client_grants + scoped token + ws_tickets
Device flow on the linked portal mints a read/write token
kept on the device; POST /api/ws-ticket trades it for a
one-use ticket for /ws/client?ticket=...
portal_connections on the home: metadata only
No identity merge; email is a label, never a key.
Linked admin policy: off by default, allowlist, max_scope.
Home-served code can read device tokens: explicit trust.
Design only, no code. v1 is foreground-only: background push across portals (home notification relay) is deferred. Self-hosting packaging is a separate track.
